name: rel
description: Browse with REL's persistent Chromium sessions, domain-specific skills, diagnostics, and restartable crawlers.

interface.shortDescription: Browse with persistent local Chromium sessions.
interface.longDescription: Control REL's app-owned Chromium sessions from Codex. Read pages, perform native browser actions, inspect non-blocking session diagnostics, export bounded debug bundles, and build restartable crawlers through the local MCP adapter. Available tools come from the installed REL app. Includes site-specific guidance for Reddit, Zillow, Craigslist, Google Search, X, DuckDuckGo, and LoopNet.
defaultPrompt: Capture this URL with REL and summarize the page.
Use my existing REL session to inspect the current page.
Design a restartable REL crawl for this website.
Diagnose the failed navigation in my REL Session using its trace and debug state.
